Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. Stopping the fstrim thread on a live filesystem exposes an exit path in ext4_mb_fstrim_thread() that was harmless when the thread was only stopped at umount. The comments apply to every copy of ext4-add-fstrim-mount-option.patch, not just rhel10.0. This is also a user-visible behaviour fix with no test; could a conf-sanity case that mounts ldiskfs directly and runs remount,ro/rw and remount,fstrim/nofstrim be added?

commit.subject: LU-21161 ldiskfs: start/stop fstrim thread at remount
commit.message:
LU-21161 ldiskfs: start/stop fstrim thread at remount

The fstrim thread is only started at mount and stopped at umount,
so it does not follow fstrim/nofstrim or ro/rw changes at remount.
"remount,fstrim" never starts it, "remount,nofstrim" leaves it
running, and "remount,ro" makes its journal handles fail with
-EROFS (with a warning on newer kernels), so it never trims again.

Start or stop the thread at the end of remount according to the
mount options and the read-only state, and make
ext4_mb_fstrim_start() return early for a read-only filesystem or
an already running thread.

Fixes: 9aae55cf25f5 ("LU-17980 ldiskfs: add fstrim mount option")
